# SCI-CAL v0.1 Engineering Conformance r0.2 Change Log

Date: `2026-08-20`

Scope: bounded repair aligning the formal engineering view with Science-Team
Rationale r0.3. The science rationale is unchanged. All stable assumption,
requirement, and edge IDs are preserved.

## Corrections

- Carries Q01--Q09 as explicit owner-authority gates with their exact
  claim-specific consequences.
- Distinguishes Beammap/source-APT scientific production, TolProj association
  and approved child transformation, TolTECA delivery, SCI-CAL consumption,
  and MAP/FLT response ownership.
- Requires source and observation-specific child APT identities plus a complete
  producer-owned `flxscale` generating record.
- Requires child-transformation identity, transfer-validity domain, retained
  systematics, and immutable delivery identity.
- Adds the broadband photometric-convention compatibility state connecting
  source factor, target atmosphere, and reported output.
- Adds the pre-CAL boundary and pipeline-order state and prevents local CAL
  algebra from becoming an unsupported end-to-end response claim.
- Corrects the conclusion: binding the atmosphere operator resolves Q06 only
  and does not promote any Q01--Q05 or Q07--Q09 claim.
- Refreshes crosswalks, package governance, document metadata, and proposed
  evidence without inspecting implementation or validation results.

## Non-changes

- Contract version remains `v0.1` and engineering document revision becomes
  `r0.2`.
- Science rationale remains `r0.3` and its canonical PDF is unchanged.
- The factor algebra, atmosphere equations, uncertainty equations, response
  equations, opacity limits, and formal ID inventories are unchanged.
- No owner decision is resolved and no implementation, validation, or
  production claim is made.
